lines.zh: 我踩着草甸的短草，蹄子很轻。
lines.en: I cross the meadow on light little hooves.

lines.zh: 雪坡上一步一滑，我走得很慢。
lines.en: On the snowy slope I slip at every step.

lines.zh: 樱花树下落了一层粉，我踩过去。
lines.en: A pink layer lies under the cherry tree; I walk through it.

lines.zh: 山脊风大，我的毛被吹歪了。
lines.en: The ridge wind is strong and blows my wool sideways.

lines.zh: 我跟着羊群走，前后都是毛球。
lines.en: I follow the flock, wool balls ahead and behind.

lines.zh: 这块草太短，我换一片吃。
lines.en: This grass is too short; I move to another patch.

lines.zh: 石头缝里有草，我探头去够。
lines.en: Grass grows in a stone crack and I reach in.

lines.zh: 下坡时我小跑，蹄声哒哒的。
lines.en: I trot downhill, hooves tapping out a rhythm.

lines.zh: 雪沾在蹄子上，凉得我直跳。
lines.en: Snow sticks to my hooves and I hop from the cold.

lines.zh: 我绕着樱花树走，影子跟着转。
lines.en: I circle the cherry tree and my shadow circles too.

lines.zh: 草甸尽头有片更高的草。
lines.en: Past the meadow's edge the grass grows taller.

lines.zh: 别掉队，我回头看看同伴。
lines.en: Don't fall behind; I look back for the others.

lines.zh: 一口草要嚼很久，我才有滋味。
lines.en: I chew each mouthful a long time to taste it.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛吹成一朵云。
lines.en: The wind fluffs my wool into a small cloud.

lines.zh: 我站着打盹，眼睛半闭。
lines.en: I doze on my feet with my eyes half shut.

lines.zh: 雪坡上太安静，只听见呼吸。
lines.en: The snow slope is so quiet I only hear breathing.

lines.zh: 有片花瓣落在我背上，我不动。
lines.en: A petal lands on my back and I keep still.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，羊毛里掉出草屑。
lines.en: I shake and bits of grass fall from my wool.

lines.zh: 山风里有别的羊的味道。
lines.en: The mountain wind carries the smell of other sheep.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的石头，数到七。
lines.en: I count the distant stones and get to seven.

lines.zh: 肚子饱了，我就想躺下。
lines.en: With a full belly I just want to lie down.

lines.zh: 草根有点甜，我再咬一口。
lines.en: The grass roots are sweet, so I bite once more.

lines.zh: 我的毛又长长了，有点沉。
lines.en: My wool has grown again and feels heavy.

lines.zh: 樱花落在鼻尖，我打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: A cherry blossom lands on my nose and I sneeze.

lines.zh: 这处山坳背风，适合歇脚。
lines.en: This hollow is out of the wind, good for resting.

lines.zh: 我抬头看云，忘了嚼嘴里的草。
lines.en: I look up at the clouds and forget the grass in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱了拱雪，底下的草是绿的。
lines.en: I nuzzle the snow; the grass beneath is green.

lines.zh: 远处的铃铛响，是别的羊。
lines.en: A bell rings far off. Another sheep.

lines.zh: 我把脸埋进毛里，暖和。
lines.en: I bury my face in my wool. Warm.

lines.zh: 这里的花都是小的，正好一口。
lines.en: The flowers here are small, one mouthful each.

lines.zh: 你比山脊上的石头还高。
lines.en: You stand taller than the stones on the ridge.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，嘴里还嚼着草。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you, still chewing.

lines.zh: 你手上有小麦的味道吗？
lines.en: Do your hands smell of wheat?

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我退了两步又停下。
lines.en: You crouch; I back off two steps and stop.

lines.zh: 你挡了太阳，我站进你的影子里。
lines.en: You block the sun, so I stand in your shadow.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的剪刀，往旁边挪。
lines.en: I eye your shears and shuffle aside.

lines.zh: 你靴子上有樱花瓣，我看见了。
lines.en: There is a cherry petal on your boot; I see it.

lines.zh: 我眨眨眼，猜你要不要摸我。
lines.en: I blink, wondering if you want to pet me.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里沙沙响，是什么？
lines.en: Something rustles in your pocket; what is it?

lines.zh: 仰头看你看久了，我的脖子发僵。
lines.en: Looking up at you this long has stiffened my neck.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我不那么怕了。
lines.en: When you laugh, I am a little less afraid.

lines.zh: 我小声叫了一下，你听见没？
lines.en: I bleat softly; did you hear it?

lines.zh: 咩！我的毛都炸起来了。
lines.en: Baa! My wool is standing on end.

lines.zh: 疼得我钻进草里，只露出尾巴。
lines.en: It hurts so much I burrow in, tail showing.

lines.zh: 我只有八点命，别再来一下。
lines.en: I have only eight points; not another blow.

lines.zh: 血渗进白毛里，很难看。
lines.en: Blood seeps into my white wool, ugly to see.

lines.zh: 我跑起来一瘸一拐的。
lines.en: I run with a limp on one leg.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得眼冒白光。
lines.en: That blow made white light flash in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我叫得嗓子都哑了。
lines.en: I bleated until my throat went raw.

lines.zh: 羊毛被扯掉一撮，真疼。
lines.en: A tuft of wool was torn out; it stings.

lines.zh: 我缩到同伴中间，躲一躲。
lines.en: I squeeze among the flock to hide.

lines.zh: 再打，我就跑下雪坡了。
lines.en: Hit me again and I run down the snow slope.

lines.zh: 小麦！我闻到那股干草味了。
lines.en: Wheat! I catch that dry stalk smell.

lines.zh: 你手里的麦穗在晃，我走不动。
lines.en: The wheat sways in your hand and my legs stop.

lines.zh: 给我一把，我就跟着你走。
lines.en: Give me a handful and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，够你的手。
lines.en: I stretch my neck toward your hand.

lines.zh: 麦粒掉在地上，我赶紧去捡。
lines.en: Wheat seeds fall and I hurry to get them.

lines.zh: 为了小麦，我连雪坡都敢下。
lines.en: For wheat I will even go down the snowy slope.

lines.zh: 你的手放低些，我够得着。
lines.en: Lower your hand a little so I can reach.

lines.zh: 我蹭你的腿，换一把麦子。
lines.en: I rub against your leg for another handful.

lines.zh: 这味道让我忘了同伴在哪。
lines.en: This smell makes me forget where the flock went.

lines.zh: 麦穗再晃两下，我就靠过去了。
lines.en: Wave that wheat twice more and I come over.

lines.zh: 哎，你踩到我的蹄子了！
lines.en: Hey, you stepped on my hoof!

lines.zh: 我这么小，你都没看见我吗？
lines.en: I am this small; did you really not see me?

lines.zh: 被撞一下，我滚进了草丛。
lines.en: One bump and I roll into the grass.

lines.zh: 一撞之下，白毛全粘在你裤脚。
lines.en: One bump and white wool clings to your cuffs.

lines.zh: 你退后时，我正好顶到你膝盖。
lines.en: When you stepped back, I butted your knee.

lines.zh: 别挤，羊群里已经够挤了。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; the flock is crowded enough.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我头上的毛全乱了。
lines.en: That knock left the wool on my head a mess.

lines.zh: 我踉跄两步，才站稳。
lines.en: I stumble two steps before I find my feet.

lines.zh: 你脚下留情，我只有八点命。
lines.en: Go easy with those feet; I have only eight points.

lines.zh: 撞完我还得梳理羊毛，真麻烦。
lines.en: Now I must tidy my wool again; such a nuisance.

lines.zh: 小麦的味道让我想找个伴。
lines.en: The smell of wheat makes me want a mate.

lines.zh: 我绕着另一只小羊转圈。
lines.en: I circle around another little sheep.

lines.zh: 我们的毛蹭在一起，暖暖的。
lines.en: Our wool presses together, warm and soft.

lines.zh: 草甸这角很软，就这儿吧。
lines.en: This corner of the meadow is soft; here.

lines.zh: 我低下头，轻轻顶了顶她。
lines.en: I lower my head and nudge her gently.

lines.zh: 樱花落下来，盖住我们俩。
lines.en: Cherry petals fall and cover the two of us.

lines.zh: 她叫一声，我也叫一声。
lines.en: She bleats once, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我们正凑在一起，你先走开。
lines.en: We are pressed together just now; walk on.

lines.zh: 过些日子，会多一只小毛球。
lines.en: In a while there will be one more wool ball.

lines.zh: 我守着她，草都忘了吃。
lines.en: I stay by her and forget to eat.

lines.zh: 我叼起一根草茎，嚼了两下。
lines.en: I pick up a stem and chew it twice.

lines.zh: 花瓣粘在嘴边，我甩不掉。
lines.en: A petal sticks by my mouth and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 这块草皮我拖不动，算了。
lines.en: I cannot drag this turf; never mind.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子扒拉两下石头。
lines.en: I scrape a stone twice with my hoof.

lines.zh: 羊毛里缠了根树枝，真烦。
lines.en: A twig is tangled in my wool, annoying.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的麦粒，我一颗颗捡。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen wheat seeds one by one.

lines.zh: 我试着顶起木棍，它滚走了。
lines.en: I try to lift a stick and it rolls away.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满草，我叫不出来。
lines.en: My mouth is full of grass and I cannot bleat.

lines.zh: 有片叶子挂在我耳朵上。
lines.en: A leaf is hanging on my ear.

lines.zh: 我捡到的只有草，别的不会。
lines.en: All I ever pick up is grass, nothing else.

lines.zh: 草丛里有动静，我抬起头。
lines.en: Something moves in the grass and I look up.

lines.zh: 那只狼的影子，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the shadow of that wolf.

lines.zh: 我盯住那边，先不动。
lines.en: I fix on that spot and hold still.

lines.zh: 有东西在石头后面呼吸。
lines.en: Something is breathing behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我把小羊往身后挡了挡。
lines.en: I shift the lamb behind me a little.

lines.zh: 这味道不对，不是草。
lines.en: That smell is wrong; it is not grass.

lines.zh: 我盯上那只靠近的狐狸。
lines.en: I have my eye on the fox creeping closer.

lines.zh: 蹄子已经准备好跑了。
lines.en: My hooves are already set to run.

lines.zh: 我不想打，但得看着它。
lines.en: I don't want to fight, but I must watch it.

lines.zh: 它再近一步，我就叫。
lines.en: One more step from it and I bleat.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，眼睛不离它。
lines.en: I crouch low without taking my eyes off it.

lines.zh: 风把它身上的味道送到我鼻子里。
lines.en: The wind carries its scent straight to my nose.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到羊群外侧。
lines.en: I ease my way to the outside of the flock.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的蹄子就绷紧。
lines.en: When it moves, my hooves go tense.

lines.zh: 我在算跑到山坡要几步。
lines.en: I am counting the steps to the hillside.

lines.zh: 别叫，别叫，先看看。
lines.en: Don't bleat, don't bleat; watch first.

lines.zh: 我把角低下来，虽然很小。
lines.en: I lower my horns, small as they are.

lines.zh: 它往左边绕，我把头也转左边。
lines.en: It swings left, and my head swings left too.

lines.zh: 心跳得很快，草也不吃了。
lines.en: My heart races and I stop eating grass.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就用头顶它。
lines.en: Any closer and I will butt it.

lines.zh: 我用小脑袋顶了它一下！
lines.en: I butt it with my little head!

lines.zh: 这一撞轻得像棉花，可我还是撞了。
lines.en: The blow lands soft as cotton, but I landed it.

lines.zh: 我前蹄刨地，然后冲过去。
lines.en: I paw the ground and charge.

lines.zh: 它退了半步，我胆子大了。
lines.en: It steps back and my courage grows.

lines.zh: 我撞完就躲到同伴身后。
lines.en: After the hit I hide behind the flock.

lines.zh: 羊毛挡住了它的爪子，一下。
lines.en: My wool caught its claw, just once.

lines.zh: 我咩咩叫着，声音比撞得响。
lines.en: I bleat louder than I actually hit.

lines.zh: 顶完这一下，我腿都软了。
lines.en: After that butt my legs feel weak.

lines.zh: 我护着小羊，谁也别过来。
lines.en: I guard the lamb; nobody comes near.

lines.zh: 八点生命，我拿来赌这一撞。
lines.en: Eight points of life, all bet on this one charge.

lines.zh: 我在草甸的晨雾里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the meadow's morning mist.

lines.zh: 雪坡上很冷，我的毛刚长齐。
lines.en: The snow slope is cold and my wool just filled in.

lines.zh: 樱花落在刚出生的我身上。
lines.en: Cherry petals fall on me, newly born.

lines.zh: 山峰的风把我吹得站不稳。
lines.en: The peak wind nearly blows me off my feet.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是一排石头。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a row of stones.

lines.zh: 脚下是软草，我试着走两步。
lines.en: Soft grass below; I try two steps.

lines.zh: 羊群在那边，我朝它们走去。
lines.en: The flock is over there, so I head toward it.

lines.zh: 我的毛还湿着，贴在身上。
lines.en: My wool is still wet and flat against me.

lines.zh: 这处山坳有草有水，很好。
lines.en: This hollow has grass and water; good.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，没人应，再叫。
lines.en: I bleat once, no answer, so I bleat again.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片草甸归我吃。
lines.en: From today this meadow is mine to graze.

lines.zh: 母亲用鼻子推了推我，走吧。
lines.en: Mother nudges me with her nose: let's go.

lines.zh: 我的羊毛一沾火就卷成黑团。
lines.en: One touch of flame and my wool curls black.

lines.zh: 从山崖滚下去，我的毛挂满碎石。
lines.en: Rolling off the cliff, my wool fills with gravel.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的蹄子，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water rises past my hooves and I cannot float.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我掀过山脊。
lines.en: The blast throws me right over the ridge.

lines.zh: 箭穿过羊毛，扎进了皮里。
lines.en: An arrow goes through the wool and into my skin.

lines.zh: 紫色的光钻进毛里，我发晕。
lines.en: Purple light seeps into my wool and my head swims.

lines.zh: 草被雪盖住了，我饿得发抖。
lines.en: Snow covers the grass and I shiver with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我时，羊毛全立了起来。
lines.en: When the bolt hit, every strand of wool stood up.

lines.zh: 我掉进没有草的地方，一直落。
lines.en: I fall into a place with no grass, and keep falling.
